method: Actual PNG viewed in the independent child context; complete actual submitted sidecar prompt/history and batch source contracts compared with current source template/handlers and matching real baseline where available. No generation or product runtime tests.
selectedState: Three narrow Git plugin settings positions: clean disabled full content/dirty long fields/conflict

functionalFindings.finding: B adds visible horizontal scrollbars with left/right arrow controls below both single-line author inputs. Actual string fields are plain AInput, whose text scrolls internally with the caret, and have no scrollbar/arrow-button controls. The raster introduces unsupported input controls.
functionalFindings.sourceEvidence: PluginManager.vue:728 string fallback is AInput v-model:value=values[key]; git manifest authorName/authorEmail type=string. No nested scroll widget or explicit scroll buttons.

fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Actually viewed three panels/full prompt/current parent/manifest/Git API. Disabled clean plugin can show actual Git status (status endpoint reports pluginEnabled separately, not blocked by it), uninitialized/unconnected sync and optional author/email; lifecycle/save remain real.

Dirty B disables enable but allows save/uninstall; C config conflict preserves editable values, disables save/enable and exposes reload-confirm trigger. Author/email are signature fields, not GitHub login credentials; no claimed push/network task success.

styleFindings.finding: Raster texture/shading and approximate geometry remain illustrative. Use shared flat CSS tokens and source conditional scrolling/focus/disabled behavior; no exact CSS or responsive/runtime compliance claimed.

requiredCorrections: Remove only the two visible scrollbar tracks and arrow controls in B; keep long author/email values in normal single-line input fields with native caret-driven horizontal text scrolling. Preserve exact dirty/conflict/enable/save/uninstall fields and all A/C content.
limitations: Static design review does not prove API execution, permissions, dirty/busy/close guards, focus/keyboard, persistence, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Only declared compatible state reviewed; hidden mutually exclusive branches remain separate mappings. Source-derived examples are not captured runtime results.
